title: Removes support for discount coupons that don’t have a specified end time
summary: We’re removing support for creating new amount_off coupons with a forever duration and applying these to subscriptions, subscription items, subscription schedules, invoices, invoice items, quotes, or checkout sessions. We’re removing the ability to create coupons with both a discount (using the amount_off field) and indefinite length (with duration: 'forever').
migrationNotes: You can no longer attach forever and amount_off coupons to subscriptions. Instead, directly attach amount_off coupons to the invoices you want to discount. You can do this through the Invoices API, the Dashboard, or in response to a webhook event.

We’re removing the ability to create [coupons](https://docs.stripe.com/api/coupons.md?api-version=2025-03-31.basil) with both a discount (using the `amount_off` field) and indefinite length (with `duration: 'forever'`).
